item.title: 任何以他的自杀为理由不将杰西·利弗莫尔列入最伟大交易者名单的人都完全不知道他是谁
item.description:
任何以他的自杀为理由不将杰西·利弗莫尔列入最伟大交易者名单的人都完全不知道他是谁以及他取得了什么成就。我会把杰西列为第一。
1929 年，杰西·利弗莫尔 (Jesse Livermore) 通过做空市场赚了 1 亿美元，相当于今天的近 20 亿美元。
正确看待这一点：卖空的最大可能收益是 100%。利弗莫尔并不是偶然发现亚马逊并持有它二十年的。他通过阅读市场并在大额赌注上选择空头时机而获得了这笔财富。毫无疑问🐐

Anyone who uses his suicide as a reason not to put Jesse Livermore on the list of greatest traders is completely ignorant to who he was and what he accomplished. I would rank Jesse number one.
Jesse Livermore made $100 million shorting the market in 1929 -nearly $2 billion in today’s dollars.
Put that in perspective: the maximum possible gain on a short sale is 100%. Livermore didn’t stumble onto Amazon and hold it for two decades. He made that fortune by reading the market and timing his shorts on massive bets. Without a doubt the 🐐

@markminervini

恕我直言，任何不包括杰西·利弗莫尔和比尔·奥尼尔的名单都是不完整的。

With all do respect, any list that doesn't include Jesse Livermore and Bill O'Neil is incomplete.

item.title: 昨天的上涨可能看起来令人印象深刻，大量股票上涨了 10%、20%，甚至 30%。但当你正确
item.description:
昨天的上涨可能看起来令人印象深刻，大量股票上涨了 10%、20%，甚至 30%。但当你正确看待这些举措时，很明显市场仍有工作要做。
$QQQ 仅收复了近期跌势的一小部分，且仍低于下降的 10 日移动平均线。大多数人工智能/科技公司的名字看起来都很相似——百分比大幅上涨，但在既定的下降趋势中，图表仍然受到严重破坏。
纳斯达克和纽约证券交易所的成交量均低于前一交易日。英伟达(Nvidia)恢复其创始人的职位似乎是引发反弹的催化剂，但市场已经严重超卖并准备反弹。一日一人，不足以改变潮流。
因此，问题在于主要股指是否已经创出低点，或者昨天只是一场持续调整中的大幅超卖反弹。从历史上看，一些最大的反弹发生在熊市期间。
即使主要股指未能达到熊市修正跌幅，科技股的熊市也已经发生。有太多股票下跌了 50-80%，因此不能将这些下跌视为健康的回调。
从这里开始发生的事情才是重要的。我们需要看到后续购买、更广泛的参与和不断扩大的广度。更重要的是，在采取激进行动之前，我希望看到优质股票建立并突破稳健的基础，而不仅仅是破碎的领先股反弹回既定的下跌趋势。
利率仍然是一个障碍。美联储 10 月份会议纪要显示，政策制定者仍对通胀感到担忧，可能仍需要进一步紧缩。
从积极的一面来看，我们正在进入历史上有利的 11 月至 12 月时期，中期选举后的几个月也往往​​表现强劲，尤其是在第二年的上半年。
人们可能会争论这些历史顺风是否足以克服利率上升的环境。但我还应该指出，我们永远不会允许季节性、周期工作——或者美联储，就此而言——凌驾于市场本身实际告诉我们的之上。
这些都是需要考虑的因素，但在我的世界里，价格和数量、广度、领导力和个股的行动最终拥有最终决定权。
就目前而言，市场仍需证明自己。 http://minervini.com

Yesterday’s rally may have looked impressive, with a huge number of stocks up 10%, 20%, even 30%. But when you put those moves into perspective, it’s clear the market still has work to do.
$QQQ recovered only a relatively small portion of its recent decline and remains below a declining 10-day moving average. Most of the AI/Tech names look similar - big percentage rallies, but still badly damaged charts in well-established downtrends.
Volume on both the Nasdaq and NYSE was below the previous day. Nvidia reinstating its founder appeared to be the catalyst that ignited the rally, but the market was already heavily oversold and poised for a bounce. One day and one man are not enough to change the trend.
So the question is whether the major indexes have established a low or yesterday was simply a sharp oversold rally within an ongoing correction. Historically, some of the biggest rallies occur during bear markets.
Even if the major indexes fail to reach bear market correction percentage declines, a bear market in tech has already occurred. There are far too many stocks down 50-80%, to dismiss the declines as healthy pullbacks.
What happens from here is what matters. We need to see follow-through buying, broader participation and improving breadth. More importantly, before getting aggressive, I want to see quality stocks setting up and breaking out of sound bases - not simply broken leaders bouncing back into well-established downtrends.
Interest rates remain an obstacle. Minutes from the Fed’s October meeting showed that policymakers remain concerned about inflation and that additional tightening may still be necessary.
On the positive side, we’re entering what has historically been a favorable November-December period, and the months following midterm elections have also tended to be strong, particularly during the first half of the following year.
One could argue whether those historical tailwinds will be strong enough to overcome a rising-rate environment. But I should also point out that we would never allow seasonality, cycle work - or the Fed, for that matter - to override what the market itself is actually telling us.
Those are all factors to consider, but in my world, price and volume, breadth, leadership and the action of individual stocks ultimately have the final say.
For now, the market still has to prove itself. http://minervini.com

One could argue whether those historical tailwinds will be strong enough to overcome a rising-rate environment. But I should also point out that we would never allow seasonality, cycle work - or the Fed, for that matter - to override what the market itself is actually telling us.
Those are all factors to consider, but in my world, price and volume, breadth, leadership and the action of individual stocks ultimately have the final say.
For now, the market still has to prove itself. http://minervini.com

item.title: 今天早上的反弹可能看起来令人印象深刻，但这正是我平仓的原因。市场已经超卖到足以产
item.description:
今天早上的反弹可能看起来令人印象深刻，但这正是我平仓的原因。市场已经超卖到足以产生一场令人震惊的反弹。在下跌近 7R 后，没有理由逾期交易。
也就是说，请正确看待今天早上的行动。许多股票的涨幅高达 10%-30%，但大多数股票在图表上都只是昙花一现。目前，它们是仍处于大幅下跌趋势的股票的反趋势反弹，尤其是科技股。
标准普尔 500 指数较 10 月 6 日的历史高位下跌 11.6%，这是自 2025 年 2 月至 4 月抛售以来的首次 10% 回调，但我们尚未摆脱困境。在我们可以说有效的底部已经形成之前，还有很多工作要做。强劲的一天不会突然创造出新的上升趋势。
目前，我预计波动性仍将较高。享受这次集会，但要注意其背景。市场还需要证明自己。在这次调整结束之前，准备好支撑和填充，甚至主要股指更低的低点。
超卖市场的棘手之处在于，它总是会变得更加超卖。即使在动量触底之后，价格仍可能在背离出现的同时继续创出更低的低点。
我现在想看到的是，这种反弹能否持续一两天以上，并扩大到跌幅最严重的股票之外。这将增加年底可持续反弹的可能性。如果不能，那么我们看到的可能只是空头回补，还会有更多抛售。
更强的信号来自上行宽度推力信号，而不是下行超卖信号。例如，10:1 的上涨成交量日后的回报率高于大幅下跌成交量日后的回报率。更强烈的信息来自两个 10:1 的上涨日，而中间没有 10:1 的下跌日。等待上行确认是值得的。
假设周五低点守住，后续交易日（日/日交易量增加 1%）最早可能在本周五出现。这将是确定已形成低点的第一步。
在调整过程中，我的注意力最终转向个股和市场领导力。目前，我们的潜在候选人名单很小。市场不可能依靠被破坏的领先者的逆势反弹走得太远。为了看涨，我们需要看到更多。 http://minervini.com

This morning’s rally may look impressive, but this is exactly why I covered the shorts. The market had gotten oversold enough to produce a rip-your-face-off rally. After capturing nearly 7R on the downside, there was no reason to overstay the trade.
That said, keep this morning’s action in perspective. A number of stocks are up a whopping 10%-30%, but most are barely a blip on the charts. For now, they’re counter-trend rallies in stocks that are still in significant downtrends, particularly in Technology.
The S&P 500 fell 11.6% from its October 6 record high, the first 10% correction since the February-April 2025 selloff, but we are not out of the woods. There’s still work to do before we can say an effective bottom is in place. One strong day doesn’t suddenly create a new uptrend.
For now, I expect volatility to remain elevated. Enjoy the rally, but keep it in context. The market still has to prove itself. Prepare for backing and filling, and even lower lows in the major indexes before this correction is over.
The tricky thing about an oversold market is that it can always get more oversold. And even after momentum bottoms, price can still go on to make lower lows while divergences develop.
What I want to see now is whether this rally can last more than a day or two and broaden out beyond the most beaten-down stocks. That would increase the odds that a sustainable year-end rally can develop. If it can’t, then what we’re seeing is probably just short covering with more selling still to come.
Stronger signals have come from upside breadth thrust signals than downside oversold readings. For example, returns after 10:1 upside volume days have been higher than after big downside volume days. An even stronger message would come from two 10:1 up days without an intervening 10:1 down day. It pays to wait for upside confirmation.
A follow-through day (+1% on higher d/d volume) could occur as early as this Friday, assuming Friday’s lows hold. That would be an initial step in determining a low has been made.
During corrections, my focus ultimately turns to individual stocks and market leadership. Currently, our list of potential candidates is small. A market cannot carry itself very far on the backs of counter trend rallies in broken leaders. To get bullish, we need to see more. http://minervini.com

item.title: 现在你喜欢我的封面吗？
item.description:
现在你喜欢我的封面吗？

Do you like my cover now?

@markminervini

由于预计美中俄峰会后白宫可能会发表积极言论，我在低点附近平仓了所有空头头寸，锁定了近 7 比 1 的资金。
对于那些自 10/15 以来一直关注的人：我们以非常低的风险进入，在对我们有利的情况下进行交易，将止损移至盈亏平衡，并最终几乎捕获了整个走势。这里的市场仍然很危险，但轻松赚钱已经赚到了。这已经是最好的了。现在学校放学了。最好的祝愿。我希望那些值得的人学到一些东西。我确信评论中会包含一些娱乐内容。 http://minervini.com

In anticipation of potentially positive rhetoric coming out of the White House following the U.S. - China -Russia summit, I’m covering all of my shorts right near the lows, locking in nearly 7-to-1 on my money.
For those of you who have been following since 10/15: We entered with very low risk, pressed the trade as it worked in our favor, moved our stops to breakeven, and ultimately captured nearly the entire move. The market is still very dangerous here, but the easy money has been made. This is about as good as it gets. School is now out. Best wishes. I hope those worthy learned something. I'm sure the comments will include some entertainment. http://minervini.com
